passive.name: Flowing Flame
passive.text: Upon launching a **Quick Assist** or **Perfect Assist**, the equipper's Impact increases by **25/28.75/32.5/36.25/40%** for 8s. When the equipper launches and hits an enemy with a **Basic Attack**, apply **Wilt** to the target for 30s, stacking up to 20 times, repeated triggers reset the duration. When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of **Wilt** applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the **Ice DMG** and **Fire DMG** dealt by that attack increases by **1.5/1.72/1.95/2.17/2.4%**. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Behemoth Hunter
passive.text: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Thick Broth
passive.text: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2%**, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Passionate Construction
passive.text:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s.
When using an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Binding Chains
passive.text: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from **Basic Attacks** increase by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%** for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

substatLine: CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Special Attack > Assist > Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Moon Hunter
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Hold down Basic Attack to charge up, increasing the power of the attack and dealing **Ice DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge: Suitable Positioning
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Keep it Clean
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Slides forward, launching a series of strikes in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Etiquette Manual
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Wolf Pack
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Disrupted Hunt
entries.text:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Time to Hunt
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Hold down Special Attack to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
Hold down EX Special Attack to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: As You Wish
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Mission Complete
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Metallic Paws
entries.text:
When Lycaon charges his **Basic Attack** to completion, the attack deals **80%** increased Daze.
When **EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt** or **Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack** hits an enemy, the target's **Ice DMG RES** decreases by 25% for 30s.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Elegant Predator
entries.text:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Lycaon hits a Stunned enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%.

entries.name: Full Moon Momentum
entries.text:
When Lycaon's **EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt** hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
When he charges his **EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt** to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.

entries.name: Energy Feedback
entries.text: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's **Chain Attack**, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.

entries.name: Graceful Demeanor
entries.text: If Lycaon is attacked while using a **Basic Attack** or **Special Attack**, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s. During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

entries.name: Ruthless Hunter
entries.text:
When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s.
Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
